changes.comment: dependency refresh: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk floor ^1.29.0 → ^1.32.2, above the vulnerable ranges of GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h and the other SDK advisories (OAuth credential exposure; transitive hono, ip-address, zod and @hono/node-server advisories). Behaviour change that arrives with it: SDK 1.32 defaults the Streamable HTTP transport to redirectPolicy same-origin and calls the fetch with redirect: manual. For the default globalThis.fetch, and for any consumer fetch that is not a guarded fetch and honours init.redirect, a redirect to another origin now fails the request instead of being followed, and a method-changing 301/302/303 on a POST fails even within the origin. Requests carrying static headers still refuse every redirect. The TSDoc and README say so. Dev dependencies: minor/patch within the current major, and @types/node 20 → 22.x to match the supported Node range.
